# build-your-users-mind

Last-checked: 2026-10-29
Version: 1.1.0-dev (development, not stable)
Tests: 140 passed

License: MIT

Ecosystem: ellmos-ai
Umbrella: open-bricks

## Summary

`build-your-users-mind` is a local-first method, script set and template library for AI agents that need an evidence-backed model of their own user. It turns private interaction logs into a small "theory of us" documentation set, separates recommendations from calibrated decision predictions, and can simulate clearly labelled user wording through an optional loopback-only local model.

## Audience

- Claude Code, Codex, Gemini/agy, Kimi and other local agent operators.
- Developers building user-modeling or agent-memory workflows.
- Researchers comparing theory-of-mind, prompt archaeology and personalization methods.
- Teams that need private, inspectable decision-support memory rather than opaque SaaS profiling.

## Important files

- `README.md` - authoritative overview, 18-point quick navigation, runtime loop, and privacy boundaries.
- `README_de.md` - comprehensive German documentation with 18-point dual anchor parity.
- `NOTICE` - canonical copyright attribution notice for Lukas Geiger, ellmos-ai, and open-bricks.
- `SECURITY.md` - bilingual security and privacy policy (Local-First, Zero-Egress, Redaction boundaries).
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` - third-party software inventory and zero-runtime-dependency guarantee.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` - plain-text Level 1 SBOM companion with 10 runtime invariants and § 521 BGB disclaimer.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` - bilingual contribution guidelines, Plan D clone workflow, quality gates, and version-freeze discipline.
- `SKILL.md` - full implementation recipe for building an avatar/user model.
- `SOURCE-ADAPTERS.md` - adapter notes for Claude, Codex, Gemini/agy and Kimi logs.
- `TAXONOMY.md` - prompt-archaeology classification categories.
- `templates/START.md` - runtime loop entrypoint.
- `templates/WHAT-USER-SAID.md` - evidence-based rule template.
- `templates/WHAT-WOULD-USER-SAY.md` - prediction and confidence template.
- `scripts/corpus_extract.py` - prompt extraction and redaction.
- `scripts/merge_corpora.py` - stable-ID multi-source merge.
- `scripts/chunk_corpus.py` - fresh corpus chunk manifest for classification.
- `scripts/validate_classifications.py` - strict Stage-2 completeness/collision gate.
- `schemas/classification.schema.json` - executable classification row contract.
- `scripts/aggregate_stats.py` - aggregate report helper.
- `scripts/score_predictions.py` - prediction scoring and escalation rate evaluator.
- `scripts/decision_prediction.py` - append-only decision prediction, validation, recovery scoring and calibration.
- `scripts/secure_text_avatar.py` - evidence-gated Secure-Mode text simulation with plan-only and loopback Ollama providers.
- `schemas/decision-prediction-event.schema.json` - versioned decision-event contract.
- `schemas/secure-text-avatar-output.schema.json` - safe simulated-text output contract.
- `docs/DECISION-PREDICTION-AND-SECURE-TEXT.md` - architecture, scoring and registry-integration notes.
- `docs/SIMULATION-CHANNEL-KONZEPT.md` - bounded concept for a clearly labelled simulation channel.
- `tests/test_metadata.py` - metadata, CI matrix, security, schema, discovery and zero-egress contract tests.
- `.gitignore` - excludes private corpora, generated avatar files, logs and local data.

## Disambiguation

This repository is not a hosted AI personalization SaaS, not an HR platform, not a chatbot persona collection, not a generic prompt library and not a psychological or medical diagnosis tool. It is a local-first recipe and template kit for private agent-memory and decision-support workflows.

## Safety notes

Never commit a real user corpus, filled avatar files, private logs, `.env` files, databases or generated decision records. Built-in redaction is not a universal sensitive-data detector; operators must add reviewed domain rules. Generated preferences are uncertain hypotheses, not diagnoses or authority grants. External, irreversible, novel, or high-impact action requires direct confirmation.
